task_title: Quantify formatting-only patch overhead without changing runtime semantics or approved extraction scope
task_body: In an independent unique scratch copy of freshly verified materialized source, test whether blank-line grouping around added Gomad fields prevents gofmt from realigning unrelated runtime2 fields. Regenerate index-free U3/U1 measurements for this scratch experiment and compare Go token streams including every comment against the measured current source. Determine whether this source-text-only hypothesis can close the literal original-baseline R8 gap; do not ship or adopt the candidate.
acceptance: Change only own scratch and task5/alignment-experiment artifacts. Preserve every field's name/type/order, every token/comment and all current behavior; no embedding, relocation, renamed fields, deleted comments/features, policy changes or baseline substitution. No shared source, generation, builds/tests of Gomad, Flow or Git index/history mutations. Report exact code/token equivalence coverage, gofmt version, patch counts/hashes and remaining gap. Token equality is source evidence, not native qualification or scope approval.
